column2: [intro]
I smoked my last pack in just thirty minutes,
With every puff, I forget all my troubles in a spin,
The smoke rises, it feels so sublime,
But now I’m craving, it’s abstinence time.
I smoked my last pack, I’m in a state,
But I’m determined, I’ll find a way to quit,
Cigarette, cigarette, you’ve cast your spell,
But I’m resolved, this time you can go to hell.
I tried the patches, nicotine gum too,
But nothing works, I still crave you,
I count the days, the hours, each fleeting minute,
The cigarette’s absence, my life’s in a limit.
I smoked my last pack, I’m in a state,
But I’m determined, I’ll find a way to quit,
Cigarette, cigarette, you’ve cast your spell,
But I’m resolved, this time you can go to hell.
[ solo ]
Cigarette, it's over, I turn the page,
I’ll breathe fresh air, free from your cage,
And if I fail, I'll try again without despair,
For my will is strong, I want to live without smoke, with care.
[outro]
